Hymn 199: He Is Risen!
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: C Major
Composer: Joachim Neander
Lyricist/Text Author: Cecil Frances Alexander
Category: Easter

This is hymn number 199 titled "He Is Risen!" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joachim Neander and the lyrics were written by Cecil Frances Alexander.
This hymn is categorized under: Easter.
